user_request: Event group chat详情页面的更多按钮点击，直接弹出举报Group chat页面，样式和举报Event页面一样
scope: Direct group-chat report entry and canonical report target, not whole-page acceptance
implementation: Reuse src/pages/events/report.vue and all its existing styles; group mode changes title, context-aware copy, reasons and target only. Do not clone the UI or add a second report Store.
entry: evGroup.openGroupMenu.click.1 now calls group-report navigation directly; old menu mute/participants/detail/manage/report/close entries are retired. Existing detail-page participant and attendance actions and Store notification preferences remain intact.

data.permission: Authenticated current account and currently joined exact event/group at entry and submission
data.history: Use the same reports collection and report_subject getter; hydrate safely after leaving the event; never relabel an old event report as a group report
data.side_effects: No attendance, group access, messages, relations, coins or notification changes
data.delivery: Persisted concern only; no claim of remote delivery or moderation
